company_row.eventDescription: One company from the register search: name, number, status, type, incorporation date, registered address, postcode and SIC codes with descriptions. A run that finds nothing is free.

company_detail.eventDescription: One company with its profile and officers: accounts and confirmation-statement due dates, overdue flags, previous names and active directors and secretaries. Charged instead of Company when details are on.
